name: Side-lying Leg Press
summary: Lying on the side with one foot on the footbar, press out while keeping the hips stacked.

layers.title: Parallel press
layers.text: Hips stacked, foot flat on the bar.

layers.title: Turn the leg out
layers.text: Heel on the bar, knee to the ceiling.

layers.title: Pulses in the bend
layers.text: Small presses with the knee bent.

cautions.note: Check hip position against the client's surgeon or physio advice.

cues:
Hips stacked; the top one doesn't roll back.
Waist lifted off the carriage.
Knee in line with the hip and toes.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Lighter spring if the pelvis moves
